title: Saturation
text: Limit input signal to the upper and lower saturation values, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Upper limit} sets the upper saturation boundary for the input, {Lower limit} sets the lower saturation boundary for the input, {Treat as gain when linearizing} sets the gain value, {Enable zero-crossing detection}, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Output data type} sets the output data type, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Upper limit
params.values: Upper saturation boundary for the input signal 0.5 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Lower limit
params.values: Lower saturation boundary for the input signal -0.5 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Treat as gain when linearizing
params.values: Specify the gain value on (default) | off

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify the rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero
